matters/3/text.current_value:
ARAQUEREYNA assisted Turkish Airlines (THY) during a tax audit process initiated by the Ministry of Tourism in relation to the special tourism tax applicable to tourism service providers. Maria Carolina Cano and Manuel Reyna led the matter, with María Alejandra García and Samuel Morales on the team.

The tax audit procedure closed with a Resolution determining an amount equivalent to 1% of the total amount of the tax assessment, including fine and interests. The matter value is confidential and is stated to be a seven-figure amount.

Remove the seven-figure detail, retain supported tax work and independently stated legal result. Do not ask for disclosure permission or change matter publication classification.

matters/0/text.current_value:
ARAQUEREYNA’s Tax and Corporate teams advised Gruppo Montenegro on its acquisition of the Venezuelan Pampero rum brand from Diageo and on the Venezuelan operation, production, commercialisation and distribution of the brand. The mandate involved Venezuela, Italy and the United Kingdom and was led by María Carolina Cano, Manuel Reyna and Gustavo Reyna.

The tax work included analysis and identification of the applicable direct and indirect taxation, income tax, VAT, the Alcohol and Spirits Tax Act, customs regimes and municipal taxation. The acquisition completed on 17 July 2024; the client’s local legal organisation and permitting process for direct operation, production and distribution in Venezuela remain in progress.

Through a joint work, coordinated by Andrea Di Dio, of DLA Piper Italy, ARAQUEREYNA's Tax and Corporate Departments advised Gruppo Montenegro (a leading Italian Food and Spirits manufacturer) on all the legal aspects related to the acquisition of the Venezuelan rum brand Pampero from Diageo and on the operation, production, commercialization, and distribution of such brand in Venezuela, which enjoys the attributes and protection of the Denomination of Controlled Origin “Ron de Venezuela.”
Analysis and identification of the taxation applicable to the transactions carried out, from the tax perspective, including direct and indirect taxation (IT, VAT), Alcohol and Spirits Tax Act, Customs Regimes and Municipal Taxation.
